summary: Re-run eval-precision with RETRIEVAL_QUALITY_FILTER=on across the 3 configs (live x2 / live x10 / fixed x10); record the precision lift in tuning-experiment.md and conclude whether the tuning levers show real signal on a clean pool (does mean precision jump from ~0.20, and do config gaps widen?).

resolution.note: Re-ran eval-precision with RETRIEVAL_QUALITY_FILTER=1 across the 3 configs. Mean precision@10: live x2 0.24 (was 0.20), live x10 0.24, fixed x10 0.23. Modest lift where junk took slots (cosmology x10 0.80->0.90, the One 0.10->0.20) but NOT the unlock (hypothesised 0.5). Config gaps did not widen → tuning still not the lever. Reason: the filter can't re-rank (vectors carry the boilerplate) and the retrieved chunks are often genuinely off-topic, not just boilerplate-laden. Settles tune-vs-repair: the fix is upstream re-embed on clean text. Report: tuning-experiment.md Round 2b.
